Electromagnetic Hypersensitivity

By: Eugene Botha | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
.......could you be suffering from Electromagnetic Hypersensitivity and do not know it?

Unique Selling Point:
It is a worldwide medical phenomenon that is also on the increase in South Africa.

Summary:
Electromagnetic Hypersensitivity is a growing health phenomenon worldwide and while not universally accepted as a medical problem, in countries like Swede and the UK it is recognized as a medical condition. It is rapidly on the increase and it seems it is also on the increase in South Africa. People report diverse symptoms, that go away when they are removed from electromagnetic fields/radiation. It seems to be linked to increased Wi-fi and cell phone towers.

Further information:
Electromagnetic Hypersensitivity is a growing health phenomenon worldwide and while not universally accepted as a medical problem, in countries like Swede and the UK it is recognized as a medical condition. It is rapidly on the increase and it seems it is also on the increase in South Africa.
We received the following from a group of EHS sufferers in South Africa. I have made contact with them and there are amazing and disturbing stories: We are a society of EMF sensitive sufferers otherwise known as EHS. Below is a story of one of our members that recently joined. But we all have these terrifying stories to tell and we need to be heard. Many people are dying, and the environment, especially flying species are severely under threat. Yet no one is bringing justice. We don't need these technologies and were fine without them 10 years ago. It is not worth it and too many people are being hurt and killed for the sake of so called 'entertainment' and money for others. Wifi can rarely be compared to the value of life. And there are other ways to connect. Are we this primitive? Please see the story attached. I have many similar stories for you. Furthermore I have travelled the country and there is literally no where where EHS people can hide. I proposed sanctuaries in the Karoo, but EMF free zones were only made for astronomy research SKA. Yet nothing for people or threatened species of EMF, like birds.

One of the stories:
In October 2016 a LTE tower was erected on top of a 28m high pole directly in front of my home and in a valley which meant that the antenna head was level with my house and 168m away. This pole was supposed to be the new home of CCTV cameras for the Durban municipality. To date there have been no cameras installed on the pole. There was however a LTE antenna array system installed by MTN. Our family developed insomnia, anxiety, anger and depression. My symptoms grew worse to the point that I was so depressed of the constant fighting with my wife and kids that I tried to commit suicide. My two sons found me with my gun against my head and eventually talked me out of the situation. My wife was acting with similar symptoms and we eventually called our marriage off and I left our residence. My youngest son left with me and after spending the night sleeping in the car he talked me into going back home. The same evening, I was watching a National Geographic program on the effects of radiation from overhead powerlines and something started to make sense. I then started to research the subject and within an hour I found the root cause of my issues. I then spoke to all my neighbours around me and between the pole and my place and found that we all had the same symptom all of which started in October and November 2016. All the woman in the area have lower back pain and unexplained weight gain from between 15-20 kg. Two of the men had also experienced suicidal tendencies and a number of marriages where hanging in the balance. Becoming aware of the real problem, our families are back together. After chatting to similar groups in Johannesburg and Cape town we found the same issues around LTE towers. We wake up at about 12.30 due to the fact that our bodies do not produce enough Melatonin when we are exposed at night. I have spoken to Tower technicians who stated shortfall in planning around these local towers and the fact that they are aware of long-term side effects of being exposed to these types of frequencies. I can also not sell my house because of no one wants to buy near Cell towers. My wife and two kids have now been forced to sleep with me in the servants’ quarters situated at the rear of the residence as the house acts as a buffer to these radio waves. From knocking door to door in our area I have also ascertained that there are at least 25 other households acting exactly the same over a 700 m distance from this pole. Further research confirmed that MTN had paid for the poles to be erected by the municipality... please contact me for the rest - too many words for your web-template.

We have many more case studies and one is Elsa Retief, who heads the group and lives within a small area in her parents’ home under a special Faraday blanket. She was a professional with her own company and had to give it all up.

We also visited Green Bank in the US where there is radio silence and no electromagnetic pollution and met people from all over the world who lock there to escape the effects of EHS.

Press Release:



Electromagnetic Hypersensitivity
It’s a little known medical condition but Electromagnetic Hypersensitivity is a growing health concern worldwide. With increased exposure to wifi and cell towers, patients report diverse symptoms of illness, which only seem to dissipate when they are far away from electromagnetic fields or radiation. Carte Blanche explores this medical phenomenon.


Script:


Alwyn Lewies:
It is now 12 years since the last night I was able to sleep next to my wife.
Voice:
Alwyn and Adri Lewies from Somerset West cannot live a normal life because he is severely affected by the electromagnetic radiation emitted by cell phone towers, wifi, and mobile devices.
Alwyn:
For four years I lived on farms or rural areas where there is no radiation away from my family and it is now six years that I sleep in my car every night. I am driving all the way to Cape Point, close to Smutswinkel where I sleep next to the road
V/O:
This is the only way Alwyn can escape the severe effects that especially cell phone towers and wifi have on him.
Adri:
The symptoms that Alwyn experience would range anything from ringing in the ears, nausea, disorientation in a big way. The he would get the tremendous headaches to such an extent that he would stick his head in a bucket of ice water and then of course in extreme cases he would get a total black-out.
LINK 1:
Andre Lewies is suffering from a condition commonly known as EHS or Electromagnetic Hypersensitivity, and it is a growing phenomenon the world over.
V/O:
Elsa Retief also suffers from EHS and it has all but ruined her life. Elsa now spends most of her days in a space of 2 by 1 metres under a net lined with silver. It shields her from some radiation, but she still experiences constant pain, dizziness and feel disorientated. When we visited her, she came out for a short period of time to talk to us.
Question:
How much time do you spend in your cage?

Elsa:
I spend about 20 hours a day in my two square metre cage. It has affected every aspect of my life. I don’t see my friends anymore. Most of my family think that I am telling tall tales because no one else recognize it. In never really see people anymore. I used to have a company. I’ve lost my company, I have lost my car, I have lost my house.
V/O:
Her debilitating symptoms started two years ago, and she is not alone. Increasingly, severe reactions to electromagnetic frequencies are being reported globally. New kinds of wireless technologies and devices have resulted in massive amounts of high and low frequency radiation everywhere in the environment. It is also known as electro-smog. And about five to 7% of the population is extraordinarily sensitive to it.
LINK 3:
Because the symptoms vary from person to person and are sometimes non-specific, may sufferers have experienced ridicule not only from friends and family, but also from medical practitioners.
Elsa:
The medical world in South Africa unfortunately has not woken up to the crisis yet and they make it out as something psychological.
V/O:
Dr Hema Kalan is a general practitioner who has done a lot of research on EHS and electromagnetic radiation.
Hema Kalan:
The reason why it is not commonly recognized in the medical fraternity is because we do not learn about it in medical school, we do not learn about it at medical conferences, there isn’t a physical test that we can do to prove our patient has EHS.
V/O:
It is further difficult to diagnose it because the symptoms are very wide-ranging. However, thousands of South Africans claim a link between their illnesses and Electromagnetic radiation.
LINK:
And there are numerous groups, websites and Facebook pages that offer support.
V/O:
James Lech from Cape Town, also suffers from EHS and has just completed a Master’s dissertation at Rhodes University on electromagnetic radiation in South Africa. He says the term EHS is inaccurate.
James:
So I find EHS to be very misleading. A more accurate term is Electromagnetic Field Intolerance Syndrome, that is, EMFIS.
V/O:
“Intolerance” describes the condition a little better, and Lech has done ground-breaking work to prove that EHS is actually already a recognized medical syndrome. It has even been allocated ICD-10 codes.
LINK 4:
ICD-10 codes are an International Classification of Diseases Codes system used by healthcare providers to classify all medical diagnoses, symptoms and procedures.
V/O:
EMFIS as a condition is described by a number of these codes. In a South African first Lech has applied to be officially diagnosed with the syndrome.
James:
I myself, with the support of my wife, we actually had to go to the High Court where I was officially diagnosed with having EMFIS.
V/O:
Based on this recognition, Lech was also the first to apply for and receive a disability grant from Government for this syndrome. This is some vindication for EHS sufferers who were not taken seriously in the past.

So, if EHS is real, not only people with the syndrome should be concerned about radiation levels. All of us are subjected to it, and it could be harmful, even if we cannot detect it like EHS sufferers can.
Hema Kalan
Every living organism on this planet is electro-chemical in nature and we know that the electromagnetic fields interfere with human fields.
V/O:
A small percentage of the population pick this interference up and because they are intolerant to it, they then display EHS symptoms. And the interference of these electromagnetic fields is far from benign.
Hema:
There is overwhelming evidence that these electromagnetic fields are harmful to humans. We know that electromagnetic fields cause oxidative stress and oxidative stress cause mitochondrial dysfunctions and DNA damage and when you damage your DNA you can have a whole array of symptoms, ranging from autoimmune conditions, cancers, mood disorders.
Hema:
Electromagnetic fields ae definitely harmful to human beings and people who have EHS are not crazy.
V/O:
Internationally where EMFIS is recognized, there are also various regulations, monitoring the intensity of the radiation with a view to protecting vulnerable groups like children or pregnant women against over-exposure.
James:
In South Africa unfortunately there is not a single national standard for EMF radiation exposure. So there is no monitoring no protection regulation, nothing.
V/O:
This is rather astounding, because in many other countries wifi is considered potentially so harmful that it has been banned from all schools.

Dr Kalan further says that the rapidly increasing flood of EHS sufferers worldwide should serve as a wake-up call to us all.
Kalan:
We need to understand that these patients that are suffering from EHS are the canaries in the coal mine, because they are warning us of what is happening, and what we are doing to ourselves. There is no long terms study to prove the safety of Wifi. We are experimenting on our population at the moment. A vhild’ developing brain only stops developing at age 23, and we are exposing the children with Wifi at home, at school, cell phone towers, cellphones.
V/O:
In his study Lech tried to create models for radiation for use by regulators. However, private companies flatly refused to share their data, despite a legal obligation to do so. This is problematic as it could mean we are unknowingly being over-exposed to radiation.
LINK 6:
Section 24 of the Constitution enshrines for every person the right to an environment that is not harmful to their health or well-being.
V/O:
However, it seems that South Africa’s lack of clear regulation on electromagnetic frequency emissions could be eroding this basic human right, and this needs to be addressed urgently. And for the extremely sensitive like Alwyn Lewies, this cannot happen soon enough.
Alwyn:
Well, I would really like to….that will be amazing for me.

The same evening, I was watching a National Geographic program on the effects of radiation from overhead powerlines and something started to make sense. I then started to research the subject and within an hour I found the root cause of my issues. I then spoke to all my neighbours around me and between the pole and my place and found that we all had the same symptom all of which started in October and November 2016. All the woman in the area have lower back pain and unexplained weight gain from between 15-20 kg. Two of the men had also experienced suicidal tendencies and a number of marriages where hanging in the balance. Becoming aware of the real problem, our families are back together. After chatting to similar groups in Johannesburg and Cape town we found the same issues around LTE towers. We wake up at about 12.30 due to the fact that our bodies do not produce enough Melatonin when we are exposed at night. I have spoken to Tower technicians who stated shortfall in planning around these local towers and the fact that they are aware of long-term side effects of being exposed to these types of frequencies. I can also not sell my house because of no one wants to buy near Cell towers. My wife and two kids have now been forced to sleep with me in the servants’ quarters situated at the rear of the residence as the house acts as a buffer to these radio waves. From knocking door to door in our area I have also ascertained that there are at least 25 other households acting exactly the same over a 700 m distance from this pole. Further research confirmed that MTN had paid for the poles to be erected by the municipality... please contact me for the rest - too many words for your web-template. We have many more case studies and one is Elsa Retief, who heads the group and lives within a small area in her parents’ home under a special Faraday blanket. She was a professional with her own company and had to give it all up. We also visited Green Bank in the US where there is radio silence and no electromagnetic pollution and met people from all over the world who lock there to escape the effects of EHS.
